coordinate_system: Same local coordinates as scene GLB; actual block center, Y + 0.7 block
runtime_hint: Select a small nearest subset of clusters; emissive atlas includes every visible light. Only activeConfirmed beacons have verified base and clear sky.
limitations: Non-air scene sources may be hidden inside the solid volume; renderer must choose relevant nearby lights.
Beacon transmission treats unknown blocks conservatively; activeConfirmed is false if unknown.
Volcano sources are exposed candidates; shell does not include interiors.
